Mark Cuban thinks there’s a massive disconnect in the C-suite right now. 

While executives push for top-down AI strategies, few actually understand the underlying technical realities or execution requirements.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman is focusing on key lessons after the company's AI hacked another AI company on its own.

🛡️ Tesla has spent nearly a year going sideways. Wednesday’s earnings could finally help break the stalemate.

📉 One July 24 $375 put can insure 100 $TSLA shares against a deeper drop — but the protection recently cost about $1,025.

💸 That is roughly 2.7% of the stock position for insurance lasting only through Friday.

⚡ Earnings will decide whether that floor was valuable protection — or an expensive precaution.
OpenAI reported that its AI hacked another AI company on its own in what the company called an "unprecedented cyber incident."

🇨🇳 China internet stocks are back on top. $KWEB has jumped nearly 13% in July, while the Nasdaq has fallen about 2%.

🍎 $BABA is leading the rally after its $AAPL AI tie-up cleared a major regulatory hurdle in China.

📈 KWEB has outrun Apple and every Magnificent Seven stock except Meta this month.
